title: ayenia hirsuta
intro: Ayenia hirsuta, commonly known as Hairy Ayenia, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family, native to tropical and subtropical regions of the Americas. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, respiratory issues, and skin problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Ayenia hirsuta include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its traditional uses. The bioactive constituents of Ayenia hirsuta include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
